cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Move It for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to rearrange an ordinary commitment as proof that your relationship takes priority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Move your haircut and put our lunch in that slot. A diary records priorities, not just appointments.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've had that booking for weeks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you've had this friend since school. We schedule by importance, not by the date somebody wrote an entry.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They charge twenty pounds to change it today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll pay the change fee. Replace the haircut with my name, please; don't squeeze me into the margin.

reason: Make A corrective diary expertise the means of demanding visible priority for the friendship, with B fee objection causing A funded but exact replacement request.
